items.title: Universal openness of Spec(B) over Spec(A) tested on one explicit principal open for a finite generating set
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The criterion compresses universal openness of a ring-map spectrum into the openness of the image of a single principal open D(h) for h = sum x_i b_i in B[x_1,...,x_d]. The proof must run the reduction in the reverse direction: start from an arbitrary base change A -> A' and an arbitrary principal open D(g) in Spec(A' tensor_A B), rewrite g as sum a'_i tensor b_i, and then recognise a cartesian square of polynomial algebras in which the image of D(g) is exactly the inverse image of the given open. The step that is not a standard formality is that the chosen h must simultaneously encode every base change, which is why the proof needs the explicit polynomial presentation. Retained author proof at lines 21854-21875.
